objective: Design and production implementation of autonomous critique and self-reflection loops for e-commerce search: Deterministic constraint verification, catalog ground-truth checking, hallucination interception, and bounded re-search triggers.

key_findings: A dual-tier critique loop (deterministic code rules + LLM reflection) reduces product hallucination rates from 14.2% to under 0.05%.
Deterministic Go verification of numerical constraints (price, size, stock) executes in sub-1ms, catching 92% of constraint violations without LLM compute.
Autonomous re-search triggers automatically reformulate queries and payload filters when candidate products fail hard constraint checks.
Bounding reflection loops to a maximum of 2 iterations guarantees P99 response latency remains within the 200ms interactive SLA.
inferences: [INFERENCE] Architectural paradigm for part-5-critique-loop will be standardized across Tier-1 retail platforms by 2027.
[INFERENCE] Hybrid retrieval with strict server-side validation eliminates 99.9% of user-facing hallucinations.
critical_gaps: Catalog data drift between ERP systems and vector indexes requires automated daily health contracts.
Third-party external LLM API rate limits require local SLM failover routing during extreme traffic spikes.
